text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan, Manhattan Cafe! Gliding 
smoothly to the front, across the finish 
line!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooooooh...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A stellar run... No, an utterly bizarre 
run! The stadium erupts into an 
indescribable stir...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A goal crossed with firmer, surer strides 
than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The efforts accumulated day by day 
throughout spring and summer have finally 
borne fruit here.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...! My "friend" is... My "friend" 
is...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Right in front of me...! I've never been 
that close in a race before...!
choice_data_list:
Congratulations. Were you able to see 
their faces?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't go that far... But...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It was so very close... And today, I 
didn't feel exhausted at all after the 
run...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This is me... This is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She murmurs in disbelief. Her words gave 
me confidence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The physical anomalies that had 
relentlessly plagued Manhattan Cafe seemed 
to have finally vanished.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, hahahaha! Yes, good, wonderful. 
This is just right!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Everything is going right according to 
plan! I grip the valve and repeatedly open 
and close it! The pressure is just right!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right, Cafe?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's not like I trusted you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Just as you said, though... It was for the 
best not to push myself this spring. Even 
if you are rather selfish...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
When thinking about herself... she was 
including me as part of it, too. Today... 
I truly felt that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, may I take that as an expression of 
gratitude?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Oh well. Either way, let's keep this 
momentum going."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha, time to accelerate from here! 
Even faster we go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Returning triumphantly to the trainer's 
office, we decided to formulate our next 
plan.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... my body feels completely 
fine. Even now, after running the full 
3000 meters...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I think we can make it. Whether it's this 
autumn, or this winter...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "She's truly grown dependable, that Cafe."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What's the plan, Trainer? The Classic road 
ended at the same time as the Kikuka Sho, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Shall we? That might not be a bad idea. 
Pitting her against the peak of the Senior 
Class. In which case, the upcoming 'Japan 
Cup'...
choice_data_list:
No, let's aim for the Arima Kinen, which 
is a bit further down the road.

No, let's aim for the Arima Kinen a bit 
further down the road.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oho, and what's the reasoning behind that?
choice_data_list:
Because I want you to get as much rest as 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides wanting to give her some rest, 
watching today's race made me feel that 
the longer the distance, the better it 
would be for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The 2400m of the Japan Cup and the 2500m 
of the Arima Kinen. A mere 100 meters 
might make a huge difference.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho, excellent, excellent, Trainer...! 
Those scheming, flickering eyes. It's as 
though my very intellect has been 
transplanted into your brain.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Understood... The Arima Kinen... Though I 
have no idea what kind of opponents I'll 
be facing.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So, I will catch up to my "friend." To 
wrap up this year, we will surely fulfill 
both our dreams...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A "friend", huh... Well, chasing dreams is 
all well and good, but the Arima is a 
tough race.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume in her prime. To call that 
the same creature as us... Hah, give me a 
break.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Especially in the Arima Kinen— because 
those two will likely be running.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Those two currently leading the Senior 
Class. They're always trading first and 
second-place finishes.
Fwh... Fwh...! Fwh...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Fwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaah, O-O-Opera O-san, what was that 
just now? A sneeze~?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That was a stylish, triumphant laugh 
disguised as a sneeze. It seems someone 
out there is gossiping about us.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I thought it was a fan, but—it seems not. 
There's a distinctly strange presence 
about them."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Fweh? Calling it alien...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series! Beneath the glittering 
theater where we dance, something lies in 
wait.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
An elusive 'phantom'... aiming to 
overthrow the stage, you see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen. New rivals lie in wait 
for Manhattan Cafe, who has just begun to 
hit her stride.
